About the Studio
We are a small, design-focused architecture studio in Hermosa Beach specializing in high-end custom residential projects throughout Los Angeles and Orange County. Our work is focused primarily on ground-up residences, with an emphasis on thoughtful design, strong client relationships, and close collaboration with talented contractors, interior designers, landscape architects, and consultants.
We maintain a casual, collaborative studio environment while taking the quality of our architecture and project delivery seriously. As a small team, everyone has meaningful involvement in our projects, with opportunities to contribute ideas, take ownership of their work, and grow professionally as the practice evolves.
With a growing portfolio of residential work, we are looking for an experienced Senior Project Architect who is equally invested in design and the technical execution required to bring it to life. This is a hands-on role with direct involvement in projects from design development through construction, as well as the opportunity to help shape the continued growth of the studio. For the right person, the position has the potential to develop into a larger leadership role within the firm over time.
Responsibilities
Qualifications
Experience with SketchUp, AutoCAD, and Adobe Creative Suite required. Strong proficiency in Revit and/or Archicad is highly desirable.
Compensation: $110,000-$150,000+, commensurate with experience and qualifications.
To Apply
Please submit a resume and portfolio or representative work samples to [email protected]. In addition to design work and completed projects, we would particularly like to see examples of construction documents and architectural detailing that demonstrate your direct involvement in project delivery. Please briefly identify your role and responsibilities on the projects included in your submission.
